Name: Renew and deploy wildcard SSL cert and rotate internal CA cert
Description: Owner: Ben. Deadline: August 22nd (buffer before September 1st expiry). Renew and deploy the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com to the load balancers. In the same change window, rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh, which expires two weeks after the public cert. Set up cert-manager for both certs so they auto-renew going forward. Acceptance criteria: both certs renewed and deployed before August 22nd, auto-renewal configured via cert-manager for both.

Name: Restore staging parity and add schema drift monitoring
